featured.titleZh: 普京所在政党在遭受大规模无人机袭击的俄罗斯选举中保持权力
featured.summaryZh: 俄罗斯执政党统一俄罗斯党在议会选举中获得多数席位。此次选举在乌克兰无人机袭击和网络攻击的背景下进行，且未允许反战政党参选。
featured.whyImportant: 选举结果巩固了普京政府的执政地位，并显示出俄罗斯在战时环境下对政治异见的严格管控。

global.title: UK urged to strengthen financial muscle of national wealth fund to aid economy
global.summary: Unions, thinktanks and others say overhaul could provide investment Britain needs Unions, thinktanks, environmental groups and charities have come together to call on ministers to boost the financial firepower of the national wealth fund to empower it to invest more in Britain and rebalance the country’s economy. Lower energy bills, the revitalisation of the UK’s industrial heartlands and the provision of more high-quality jobs could all be unlocked by scaling up the NWF, according to a statement from organisations including the TUC, Greenpeace, WWF and the New Economics Foundation. Turbocharging the retrofitting of homes and buildings. Giving the public a bigger stake in critical infrastructure through taking part-ownership stakes in key projects. Launching a targeted investment programme to bring new green industries to communities hit hardest by deindustrialisation. Supporting a network of regional banks to funnel money into the small businesses that hold up local economies. Continue reading...

global.whyImportant: 该建议旨在通过公共投资引导英国经济转型，以应对当前的经济结构性挑战。

Moise, 53, was gunned down on July 7, 2021, at his private residence by a hired group of about 20 military-trained Colombian mercenaries. global.titleZh: 海地总统2021年遇刺案的18名嫌疑人被移送至美国受审
global.summaryZh: 美国官员周日表示，涉及2021年海地总统若弗内尔·莫伊兹遇刺案的18名嫌疑人已被转移至佛罗里达州接受审判。莫伊兹于2021年7月在其私人住所被一群受过军事训练的哥伦比亚雇佣兵枪杀，当时其安保人员未进行干预。

china.title: China tests first practical submarine solar power plant at 10-metre depth in the open sea
china.summary: In a breakthrough that could power the future of underwater operations, Chinese scientists have built and tested the world’s first submarine solar farm, successfully operating a perovskite-based photovoltaic system at a depth of 10 metres (33 feet) in the open sea. The submerged array charged batteries and powered a LED panel, proving that solar energy can be harvested even in the dim, blue-green twilight of the ocean. The achievement by a team from Yunnan University, published on September 11,...
china.titleZh: 中国在公海10米深处测试首个实用型潜水太阳能电站
china.summaryZh: 中国科学家成功在公海10米深处运行了一套基于钙钛矿的光伏系统，实现了水下太阳能发电。该系统成功为电池充电并驱动LED面板，证明了在海洋微光环境下收集太阳能的可行性。
china.whyImportant: 这项技术突破为未来水下作业的能源供应提供了新方案，具有重要的科研与应用价值。

With some leftover concrete mix in his truck, Xie volunteered to fix the road...

china.summaryZh: 业内专家指出，中国内地与香港在吸引高科技企业上市方面存在竞争，但更多表现为企业根据自身战略进行的双向选择。科技公司在选择上市地点时，会综合考量市场环境与自身发展需求，而非简单的零和博弈。
china.whyImportant: 这一分析揭示了中国科技企业在资本市场布局中的多元化策略，以及香港与内地金融市场的互补关系。

china.summary: Beijing believes slowdown calls aim to lock in US advantage, and is pursuing a different balance between safety and pace China bogeyman looms large over American firms’ AI doomsday scenario About two years ago, education entrepreneur Boris But had what he calls a “penny-drop moment” – that, like countless others in China, his company needed to embrace AI before it was made obsolete by it. china.titleZh: 中国为何反驳美国关于人工智能快速发展的警告
china.summaryZh: 北京方面认为，美国呼吁放缓人工智能发展旨在巩固其技术优势，中国正寻求在安全与发展速度之间建立平衡。随着AI技术在各行各业的普及，中国企业正积极拥抱人工智能以保持竞争力。
china.whyImportant: 中美在人工智能发展路径上的分歧，反映了全球科技竞争中关于安全监管与创新速度的博弈。

china.summary: Pascal Lamy served two consecutive terms as director general of the World Trade Organization from 2005 to 2013. Before that, he spent decades in various French government roles, contributing to the building of the European Union. He was chief of staff to European Commission president Jacques Delors from 1985 to 1994, and European trade commissioner from 1999 to 2004. Here, he discusses Europe’s trade tensions with China, the continent’s growth potential problem and the WTO’s need for stronger...
china.titleZh: 前世贸组织总干事帕斯卡尔·拉米谈欧盟对华选择：寻求再平衡还是走向保护主义
china.summaryZh: 前世贸组织总干事帕斯卡尔·拉米探讨了欧盟在对华贸易关系中的困境，强调欧盟需要在寻求贸易再平衡与避免保护主义之间做出选择。他同时指出，欧洲面临增长潜力不足的问题，并呼吁加强世贸组织的作用。
china.whyImportant: 资深贸易专家的观点为理解当前中欧贸易摩擦及欧洲经济政策走向提供了重要参考。

tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
usa.titleZh: 胡塞新一轮袭击，美国警告迅速升级，沙特紧急向多国求援
usa.summaryZh: 胡塞武装发动了新一轮袭击，导致地区局势紧张，美国对此发出警告称冲突可能迅速升级。沙特阿拉伯已紧急向多国寻求援助，以应对日益严峻的安全挑战。
usa.whyImportant: 地区安全局势的恶化可能引发更广泛的军事冲突，并对全球能源供应与地缘政治稳定造成威胁。

usa.title: US announces AI dialogue with China, launches Board of Trade
usa.summary: The United States and China agreed to establish a dialogue on artificial intelligence and put into operation a bilateral trade body following eight hours of negotiations in New York, just days before Chinese President Xi Jinping’s state visit to Washington. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Trade Representative Jamieson Greer announced the outcomes after meeting Chinese Vice-Premier He Lifeng at JPMorgan’s headquarters. “We had a very successful engagement with the Chinese on trade and...
usa.titleZh: 美国宣布与中国进行人工智能对话，并启动贸易委员会
usa.summaryZh: 中美两国在纽约经过八小时谈判后，同意建立人工智能对话机制并启动双边贸易机构。此次会谈在习近平主席访美前夕举行，旨在加强双方在关键领域的沟通与合作。
usa.whyImportant: 此举标志着中美在人工智能治理和贸易摩擦方面寻求通过对话缓解紧张关系。

usa.title: Trump and Mamdani set to meet in New York
usa.summary: US President Donald Trump will meet New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani when Trump travels to the city for the UN General Assembly. The meeting is scheduled for Monday at Gracie Mansion, the official mayoral residence, according to Anna Bahr, Mamdani’s communications director. Bahr said the two will discuss issues affecting the city and New Yorkers. The White House confirmed the meeting will take place but did not offer more details. Mamdani, a democratic socialist who upset former Governor...
usa.titleZh: 特朗普与曼达尼即将在纽约会面
usa.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普在出席联合国大会期间，计划与纽约市长曼达尼在格雷西大厦会面。双方将讨论影响纽约市及市民的相关议题。
usa.whyImportant: 此次会面体现了美国联邦政府与地方政府在处理城市事务上的互动。

usa.title: Trump reportedly to form health funding board that could veto ‘woke’ initiatives
usa.summary: President’s latest order expected to bring NIH funding under control of Trump administration to align with agenda Donald Trump’s latest executive order is expected to establish a board responsible for approving National Institutes of Health grant funding, marking another attempt by the Trump administration to censor topics that do not align with the president’s agenda. The executive order, reported by outlets including the Washington Post and Politico, was discussed in a meeting on Friday where senior administration officials accused the NIH of funding “woke” initiatives that went against Trump’s political priorities. usa.titleZh: 据报道，特朗普将组建卫生资金委员会，或可否决“觉醒”倡议
usa.summaryZh: 特朗普政府计划通过行政命令设立一个委员会，负责审批美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）的拨款。此举旨在确保科研资助与总统的政治议程保持一致，并审查被视为“觉醒”的科研项目。
usa.whyImportant: 该政策可能对美国科研资助的独立性及学术自由产生深远影响。

usa.title: Boeing’s 200-jet China deal could hinge on Trump-Xi talks: industry insiders
usa.summary: When President Xi Jinping travels to Washington later this month, he is likely to hop over the Pacific on a Boeing 747 jumbo jet. He will also hold the fate of the American planemaker’s much-touted China deal in his hands. Beijing agreed to purchase 200 Boeing aircraft during US President Donald Trump’s visit to China in May. But the deal has yet to materialise – and the negotiations could depend on the outcome of Xi’s coming meeting with Trump in the Oval Office, according to industry...
usa.titleZh: 业内人士称，波音公司200架飞机的对华订单可能取决于特朗普与习近平的会谈
usa.summaryZh: 中国此前同意购买200架波音飞机，但该协议尚未落实。业内人士认为，订单的最终交付可能取决于习近平主席与特朗普总统在华盛顿会晤的成果。
usa.whyImportant: 波音公司的商业利益与中美外交关系紧密挂钩，反映了地缘政治对大型跨国贸易的影响。

watch.title: Ukraine’s Zelensky to meet Trump in New York
watch.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has announced plans to meet US President Donald Trump in New York in the coming days as efforts intensify to revive negotiations aimed at ending the war in Ukraine. Zelensky said he had spoken to Trump by phone and discussed a range of issues ahead of the meeting, which is expected to take place while both leaders attend the United Nations General Assembly. A meeting in New York “could achieve a lot,” Zelensky wrote on Telegram on Sunday, pointing to the...

watch.titleZh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基将在纽约会见特朗普
watch.summaryZh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基宣布计划在联合国大会期间与特朗普会面，旨在推动结束乌克兰战争的谈判。泽连斯基表示，双方已通过电话讨论相关议题，并对会谈成果抱有期待。
watch.whyImportant: 此次会晤对于评估美国未来对乌克兰战争的政策立场具有重要意义。

watch.title: UK minister warns of impact of Trump’s Iran war on next month’s budget
watch.summary: Bridget Phillipson says Burnham’s past criticisms of US president not an issue as PM prepares to meet Trump at UN Next month’s budget will be made more difficult by Donald Trump’s war with Iran, one of Andy Burnham’s cabinet ministers has said, while adding she did not expect the prime minister’s previous disparaging comments about the US president to be an issue. Burnham is expected to meet Trump early next week at the UN general assembly summit in New York, the pair having previously spoken twice by phone since Burnham entered No 10. Continue reading...

watch.titleZh: 英国大臣警告特朗普的伊朗战争将影响下个月的预算
watch.summaryZh: 英国大臣布里奇特·菲利普森表示，特朗普发动的伊朗战争将增加英国下月预算制定的难度。与此同时，英国首相伯纳姆预计将在联合国大会期间与特朗普会面。
watch.whyImportant: 这表明美国的外交军事行动已对盟国的国内经济政策产生直接溢出效应。

watch.whyImportant: 武装势力的联合可能导致埃塞俄比亚国内局势更加动荡，加剧地区安全风险。

items.title: US prepares sanctions against International Criminal Court: sources
items.summary: US President Donald Trump’s administration has prepared sanctions against the entire International Criminal Court (ICC) and plans to announce them soon, two sources familiar with the matter said, ‌a move that would step up its attack on the global tribunal that prosecutes war crimes and genocide worldwide. items.titleZh: 消息人士：美国准备对国际刑事法院实施制裁

items.whyImportant: 这标志着美国与国际司法机构之间的对抗进一步升级，引发国际社会对全球司法独立性的担忧。

items.summaryZh: 叙利亚阿勒颇南部的一处弹药库发生爆炸，造成至少四人受伤。目前尚无关于爆炸原因的详细报告。
items.whyImportant: 该事件加剧了叙利亚境内本已紧张的安全局势。

items.title: Putin’s party to retain power in Russian vote marked by massive drone attack
items.summary: Vladimir Putin’s ruling United Russia party won a large majority in the country’s parliamentary elections, marked by cyberattacks and a barrage of Ukrainian drone strikes, according to results published by state media early Monday. The election, held to elect members in all seats of the lower house State Duma, is the first since Moscow launched its large-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. No party opposed to the war was allowed to run, with Russia’s Supreme Court removing the anti-war Yabloko...

items.titleZh: 普京所在政党在遭受大规模无人机袭击的俄罗斯选举中保持权力
items.summaryZh: 俄罗斯执政党统一俄罗斯党在议会选举中获得多数席位。此次选举在乌克兰无人机袭击和网络攻击的背景下进行，且未允许反战政党参选。
items.whyImportant: 选举结果巩固了普京政府的执政地位，并显示出俄罗斯在战时环境下对政治异见的严格管控。

items.title: NSW cop Beau Lamarre-Condon disguised himself as Uber Eats rider before alleged murders, court hears
items.summary: The 31-year-old former police officer has pleaded not guilty to two counts of murder as his trial begins in Sydney’s supreme court Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast A former police officer allegedly developed an “infatuation and obsession” with one of his victims, and disguised himself as an Uber Eats rider before shooting two men, a court has heard. items.summaryZh: 前警察博·拉马尔-康登因涉嫌谋杀两名男子在悉尼最高法院受审，他对此表示不认罪。检方指控其因对受害者产生痴迷而实施了犯罪行为。
items.whyImportant: 此案因涉及前警务人员的严重犯罪行为，在澳大利亚社会引起了广泛关注。

items.title: Suspected landmine blast injures South Korean soldiers in DMZ
items.summary: Three people, including South Korean soldiers, were injured in a suspected mine blast inside the demilitarised zone (DMZ), South Korea’s Yonhap News TV reported on Monday. The DMZ, which has divided the peninsula since the 1950-53 Korean war ended with an armistice, is among the most heavily mined places in the world. “A soldier was seriously injured during an operation in the DMZ involving the 25th Infantry Division,” a military official said, referring to the buffer zone separating the two...

items.titleZh: 韩国士兵在非军事区遭遇疑似地雷爆炸受伤
items.summaryZh: 韩国军方表示，三人在非军事区执行任务时遭遇疑似地雷爆炸受伤。该地区是世界上地雷分布最密集的区域之一。
items.whyImportant: 此次事故凸显了朝鲜半岛非军事区长期存在的安全风险。

items.title: Only 160 apprenticeship starts in eight months on Labour’s flagship scheme
items.summary: Exclusive: Government warned ‘skills revolution’ at risk amid slow start to project with target of 30,000 starts by end of parliament Labour has been warned its “skills revolution” to tackle youth unemployment risks failure, after its flagship apprenticeship scheme enrolled only 160 young people in its first eight months. The shortfall, highlighted in a report by the Fabian Society, leaves the government well off track of achieving its ambition of 30,000 “foundation apprenticeship” starts by the end of this parliament. items.titleZh: 工党旗舰学徒计划八个月内仅招收160人
items.summaryZh: 英国工党的“技能革命”计划在实施八个月后仅招收了160名学徒，远低于本届议会结束前达到3万人的目标。相关报告警告该计划面临失败风险。
items.whyImportant: 这一进展缓慢的现状对政府解决青年失业问题的承诺构成了严峻挑战。

items.title: ‘Disaster’: Germany’s embattled chancellor suffers bruising election defeats
items.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz suffered a bruising electoral setback in two state elections on Sunday, including a historic defeat for his party, but vowed to press ahead with potentially painful reforms to Europe’s biggest economy. Projections by public broadcaster ARD on Sunday night indicated that Merz’s centre-right Christian Democratic Union, or CDU, came in with just 4.9 per cent in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania – the lowest result since World War II for the party in any state. items.titleZh: “灾难”：德国总理陷入困境，选举遭遇惨败
items.summaryZh: 德国总理弗里德里希·默茨在周日的两场州选举中遭遇重挫，其所属政党在梅克伦堡-前波美拉尼亚州仅获得4.9%的选票，创下二战以来该党在该州的最低纪录。尽管面临历史性失败，默茨仍誓言将继续推进针对欧洲最大经济体的改革计划。
items.whyImportant: 此次选举失利削弱了默茨政府的政治权威，可能对其后续的经济改革议程产生重大阻力。

items.title: UK urged to strengthen financial muscle of national wealth fund to aid economy
items.summary: Unions, thinktanks and others say overhaul could provide investment Britain needs Unions, thinktanks, environmental groups and charities have come together to call on ministers to boost the financial firepower of the national wealth fund to empower it to invest more in Britain and rebalance the country’s economy. Lower energy bills, the revitalisation of the UK’s industrial heartlands and the provision of more high-quality jobs could all be unlocked by scaling up the NWF, according to a statement from organisations including the TUC, Greenpeace, WWF and the New Economics Foundation. Turbocharging the retrofitting of homes and buildings. Giving the public a bigger stake in critical infrastructure through taking part-ownership stakes in key projects. Launching a targeted investment programme to bring new green industries to communities hit hardest by deindustrialisation. Supporting a network of regional banks to funnel money into the small businesses that hold up local economies. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 英国被敦促加强国家财富基金的财政实力以助力经济
items.summaryZh: 工会、智库及环保组织联合呼吁政府增加国家财富基金的资金投入。他们认为此举有助于推动绿色产业发展、创造就业并重振工业地区经济。
items.whyImportant: 该建议旨在通过公共投资引导英国经济转型，以应对当前的经济结构性挑战。

items.title: 18 suspects in 2021 Haiti president’s killing sent to US for trial
items.summary: Eighteen suspects in the 2021 assassination of Haitian president Jovenel Moise have been transported to Florida to stand trial, US officials said Sunday. Moise, 53, was gunned down on July 7, 2021, at his private residence by a hired group of about 20 military-trained Colombian mercenaries. His security detail did not intervene to protect him. “Today’s multi-location and international arrests underscore the FBI’s continued commitment to bringing all participants in this plot to justice,” FBI...

items.titleZh: 海地总统2021年遇刺案的18名嫌疑人被移送至美国受审
items.summaryZh: 美国官员周日表示，涉及2021年海地总统若弗内尔·莫伊兹遇刺案的18名嫌疑人已被转移至佛罗里达州接受审判。莫伊兹于2021年7月在其私人住所被一群受过军事训练的哥伦比亚雇佣兵枪杀，当时其安保人员未进行干预。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着针对海地总统遇刺案的国际司法调查取得重要进展，体现了美国追究相关参与者责任的决心。

items.title: China tests first practical submarine solar power plant at 10-metre depth in the open sea
items.summary: In a breakthrough that could power the future of underwater operations, Chinese scientists have built and tested the world’s first submarine solar farm, successfully operating a perovskite-based photovoltaic system at a depth of 10 metres (33 feet) in the open sea. The submerged array charged batteries and powered a LED panel, proving that solar energy can be harvested even in the dim, blue-green twilight of the ocean. The achievement by a team from Yunnan University, published on September 11,...
items.titleZh: 中国在公海10米深处测试首个实用型潜水太阳能电站
items.summaryZh: 中国科学家成功在公海10米深处运行了一套基于钙钛矿的光伏系统，实现了水下太阳能发电。该系统成功为电池充电并驱动LED面板，证明了在海洋微光环境下收集太阳能的可行性。
items.whyImportant: 这项技术突破为未来水下作业的能源供应提供了新方案，具有重要的科研与应用价值。

items.title: Chinese Good Samaritan arrested for manslaughter after kindness leads to fatal accident
items.summary: Online community in China is heart-wrenched over a driver’s goodwill in pulling a rope across a road as a warning sign, which ultimately took the life of a passer-by. The case emerged after the driver, surnamed Xie, was arrested for manslaughter in central China’s Henan province on September 11. While driving along a dirt road in a village, the concrete mixer truck driver noticed potholes that caused a bumpy ride. With some leftover concrete mix in his truck, Xie volunteered to fix the road...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 中国好心人因善举导致致命事故被控过失杀人
items.summaryZh: 中国一名混凝土搅拌车司机因在路面坑洼处拉绳警示过往车辆，不幸导致一名路人死亡。该司机目前因涉嫌过失杀人被河南警方逮捕，引发了公众对于善意行为与法律责任界限的广泛讨论。
items.whyImportant: 该事件引发了社会对好心人因善意行为承担刑事责任的法律与道德争议。

items.title: For China’s hi-tech IPOs, it’s Hong Kong vs the mainland – but how much does it matter?
items.summary: Competition between mainland China and Hong Kong for hi-tech initial public offerings presents emerging technology firms with a dual-track strategic choice rather than a zero-sum battle, according to an executive at a national cross-border innovation platform. “There is naturally a degree of competition,” Lu Peng, general manager of Beijing-based Zhongguancun International, said in an interview on Thursday, referring to how tech firms select their primary listing venue. “However, the two markets...
items.titleZh: 中国高科技企业IPO：香港与内地市场如何抉择？
items.summaryZh: 业内专家指出，中国内地与香港在吸引高科技企业上市方面存在竞争，但更多表现为企业根据自身战略进行的双向选择。科技公司在选择上市地点时，会综合考量市场环境与自身发展需求，而非简单的零和博弈。
items.whyImportant: 这一分析揭示了中国科技企业在资本市场布局中的多元化策略，以及香港与内地金融市场的互补关系。

items.title: Why China is pushing back on US warnings over rapid AI development
items.summary: Beijing believes slowdown calls aim to lock in US advantage, and is pursuing a different balance between safety and pace China bogeyman looms large over American firms’ AI doomsday scenario About two years ago, education entrepreneur Boris But had what he calls a “penny-drop moment” – that, like countless others in China, his company needed to embrace AI before it was made obsolete by it. His clients, well-off parents looking to send their children to study overseas, had begun arriving in his office reeling off information and opinions gleaned not from rival firms, but from chatbots. tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 中国为何反驳美国关于人工智能快速发展的警告
items.summaryZh: 北京方面认为，美国呼吁放缓人工智能发展旨在巩固其技术优势，中国正寻求在安全与发展速度之间建立平衡。随着AI技术在各行各业的普及，中国企业正积极拥抱人工智能以保持竞争力。
items.whyImportant: 中美在人工智能发展路径上的分歧，反映了全球科技竞争中关于安全监管与创新速度的博弈。

items.title: Former WTO head Pascal Lamy on the EU’s China choice: get a rebalance, or go protectionist
items.summary: Pascal Lamy served two consecutive terms as director general of the World Trade Organization from 2005 to 2013. Before that, he spent decades in various French government roles, contributing to the building of the European Union. He was chief of staff to European Commission president Jacques Delors from 1985 to 1994, and European trade commissioner from 1999 to 2004. Here, he discusses Europe’s trade tensions with China, the continent’s growth potential problem and the WTO’s need for stronger...
items.titleZh: 前世贸组织总干事帕斯卡尔·拉米谈欧盟对华选择：寻求再平衡还是走向保护主义
items.summaryZh: 前世贸组织总干事帕斯卡尔·拉米探讨了欧盟在对华贸易关系中的困境，强调欧盟需要在寻求贸易再平衡与避免保护主义之间做出选择。他同时指出，欧洲面临增长潜力不足的问题，并呼吁加强世贸组织的作用。
items.whyImportant: 资深贸易专家的观点为理解当前中欧贸易摩擦及欧洲经济政策走向提供了重要参考。

items.title: 胡塞新一轮袭击 ， 美国警告 迅速升级 ， 沙特紧急向多国求援
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 胡塞新一轮袭击，美国警告迅速升级，沙特紧急向多国求援
items.summaryZh: 胡塞武装发动了新一轮袭击，导致地区局势紧张，美国对此发出警告称冲突可能迅速升级。沙特阿拉伯已紧急向多国寻求援助，以应对日益严峻的安全挑战。
items.whyImportant: 地区安全局势的恶化可能引发更广泛的军事冲突，并对全球能源供应与地缘政治稳定造成威胁。

items.title: US announces AI dialogue with China, launches Board of Trade
items.summary: The United States and China agreed to establish a dialogue on artificial intelligence and put into operation a bilateral trade body following eight hours of negotiations in New York, just days before Chinese President Xi Jinping’s state visit to Washington. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Trade Representative Jamieson Greer announced the outcomes after meeting Chinese Vice-Premier He Lifeng at JPMorgan’s headquarters. “We had a very successful engagement with the Chinese on trade and...
items.titleZh: 美国宣布与中国进行人工智能对话，并启动贸易委员会
items.summaryZh: 中美两国在纽约经过八小时谈判后，同意建立人工智能对话机制并启动双边贸易机构。此次会谈在习近平主席访美前夕举行，旨在加强双方在关键领域的沟通与合作。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着中美在人工智能治理和贸易摩擦方面寻求通过对话缓解紧张关系。

items.title: Trump and Mamdani set to meet in New York
items.summary: US President Donald Trump will meet New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani when Trump travels to the city for the UN General Assembly. The meeting is scheduled for Monday at Gracie Mansion, the official mayoral residence, according to Anna Bahr, Mamdani’s communications director. Bahr said the two will discuss issues affecting the city and New Yorkers. The White House confirmed the meeting will take place but did not offer more details. Mamdani, a democratic socialist who upset former Governor...
items.titleZh: 特朗普与曼达尼即将在纽约会面
items.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普在出席联合国大会期间，计划与纽约市长曼达尼在格雷西大厦会面。双方将讨论影响纽约市及市民的相关议题。
items.whyImportant: 此次会面体现了美国联邦政府与地方政府在处理城市事务上的互动。

items.title: Trump reportedly to form health funding board that could veto ‘woke’ initiatives
items.summary: President’s latest order expected to bring NIH funding under control of Trump administration to align with agenda Donald Trump’s latest executive order is expected to establish a board responsible for approving National Institutes of Health grant funding, marking another attempt by the Trump administration to censor topics that do not align with the president’s agenda. The executive order, reported by outlets including the Washington Post and Politico, was discussed in a meeting on Friday where senior administration officials accused the NIH of funding “woke” initiatives that went against Trump’s political priorities. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 据报道，特朗普将组建卫生资金委员会，或可否决“觉醒”倡议
items.summaryZh: 特朗普政府计划通过行政命令设立一个委员会，负责审批美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）的拨款。此举旨在确保科研资助与总统的政治议程保持一致，并审查被视为“觉醒”的科研项目。
items.whyImportant: 该政策可能对美国科研资助的独立性及学术自由产生深远影响。

items.title: Boeing’s 200-jet China deal could hinge on Trump-Xi talks: industry insiders
items.summary: When President Xi Jinping travels to Washington later this month, he is likely to hop over the Pacific on a Boeing 747 jumbo jet. He will also hold the fate of the American planemaker’s much-touted China deal in his hands. Beijing agreed to purchase 200 Boeing aircraft during US President Donald Trump’s visit to China in May. But the deal has yet to materialise – and the negotiations could depend on the outcome of Xi’s coming meeting with Trump in the Oval Office, according to industry...
items.titleZh: 业内人士称，波音公司200架飞机的对华订单可能取决于特朗普与习近平的会谈
items.summaryZh: 中国此前同意购买200架波音飞机，但该协议尚未落实。业内人士认为，订单的最终交付可能取决于习近平主席与特朗普总统在华盛顿会晤的成果。
items.whyImportant: 波音公司的商业利益与中美外交关系紧密挂钩，反映了地缘政治对大型跨国贸易的影响。

items.title: Ukraine’s Zelensky to meet Trump in New York
items.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has announced plans to meet US President Donald Trump in New York in the coming days as efforts intensify to revive negotiations aimed at ending the war in Ukraine. Zelensky said he had spoken to Trump by phone and discussed a range of issues ahead of the meeting, which is expected to take place while both leaders attend the United Nations General Assembly. A meeting in New York “could achieve a lot,” Zelensky wrote on Telegram on Sunday, pointing to the...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基将在纽约会见特朗普
items.summaryZh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基宣布计划在联合国大会期间与特朗普会面，旨在推动结束乌克兰战争的谈判。泽连斯基表示，双方已通过电话讨论相关议题，并对会谈成果抱有期待。
items.whyImportant: 此次会晤对于评估美国未来对乌克兰战争的政策立场具有重要意义。

items.title: UK minister warns of impact of Trump’s Iran war on next month’s budget
items.summary: Bridget Phillipson says Burnham’s past criticisms of US president not an issue as PM prepares to meet Trump at UN Next month’s budget will be made more difficult by Donald Trump’s war with Iran, one of Andy Burnham’s cabinet ministers has said, while adding she did not expect the prime minister’s previous disparaging comments about the US president to be an issue. Burnham is expected to meet Trump early next week at the UN general assembly summit in New York, the pair having previously spoken twice by phone since Burnham entered No 10. Continue reading...

items.titleZh: 英国大臣警告特朗普的伊朗战争将影响下个月的预算
items.summaryZh: 英国大臣布里奇特·菲利普森表示，特朗普发动的伊朗战争将增加英国下月预算制定的难度。与此同时，英国首相伯纳姆预计将在联合国大会期间与特朗普会面。
items.whyImportant: 这表明美国的外交军事行动已对盟国的国内经济政策产生直接溢出效应。

items.title: Ethiopian armed groups forge alliance against government
items.summary: Former adversaries say they will settle differences as fears grow of expanding war in Ethiopia.

items.titleZh: 埃塞俄比亚武装团体结成反政府联盟
items.summaryZh: 埃塞俄比亚的多个前敌对武装团体宣布结盟，以共同对抗政府。此举引发了外界对该国冲突进一步升级的担忧。
items.whyImportant: 武装势力的联合可能导致埃塞俄比亚国内局势更加动荡，加剧地区安全风险。
